items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 June 2026 5:51am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 12 June 2026 at 5:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds this afternoon.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland bringing a weak frontal trough across the south this morning.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4 soon increasing 4 or 5, then 5 or 6 early tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight building mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but some patchy light rain or drizzle possible this morning.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate in rain or drizzle at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, soon decreasing 3 to 5, veering W or NW later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of isolated showers for a time Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.
